description: This file defines the MainTabsAdapter class, an adapter for managing tab fragments in a ViewPager2 setup within an Android Kotlin application. It creates and returns the appropriate fragment based on the tab position.

classes.name: MainTabsAdapter
classes.description: An adapter class extending FragmentStateAdapter to provide fragments for each tab in the main UI.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of tabs/fragments, which is 3.

methods.name: createFragment
methods.description: Creates and returns the fragment corresponding to the given tab position.
